evidence.reason: deepFreeze is documented to recursively freeze objects and arrays, but line 13 skips traversal whenever the parent is already frozen. Object.freeze is shallow, so a shallow-frozen input such as Object.freeze({ nested: { enabled: true } }) leaves nested mutable, contradicting the function's intended recursive immutability guarantee. The fix is to traverse children even when the parent is frozen and only skip the redundant Object.freeze call.
